roleScope._comment: REQUIRED IF YOU ARE NOT IN OPERATIONS. Picks what counts as your function for the title classifier. Built-ins: 'ops' (Business/Strategy Operations) and 'product' (Product Management). Set the string alone ("roleScope": "product") to take a preset as-is, or use this object form with 'extends' plus any lists you want to override. Omit roleScope entirely and you inherit the operations scope — which will reject your own target roles if you are not in ops. See src/lib/search/role-scope.ts for every field and why each exists.
roleScope.rubricRules:
- Higher for: titles closely matching <your role family>. Lower for: <adjacent families you do not want>.
- <FAMILY> is a hard exclusion — score below 40 — even when the title also names <a word you do want>. Give the real reason, and real example titles you rejected.

SENIORITY CEILING — your reach tops out at <level>. Do NOT include <levels above it>, even if everything else matches. <Levels> are still fair game.
